sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tadeusz Pilsudski, known by his alias "Peacekeeper", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: UN Peacekeeping-force supply officer, based in one of the central checkpoints leading to the Tarkov port zone. The blue helmets have been seen poking their heads into small deals from the very beginning of the conflict, buying everything of value in exchange for western weapons, ammo, and all kinds of military equipment.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Peacekeeper is initially locked, and can be unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.
